transcribed_question:
a) Identify the area painted green?
b) Identify the structure pinned
6 (mc)
a) Renal papilla
b) Renal pyramid

marker.description: Green paint marking a specific area on the cut surface of the kidney.

main_explanation: The green paint highlights the apex of a renal pyramid, which projects into the minor calyx and is known as the renal papilla.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located in the renal sinus?
supporting_question.explanation: The renal sinus is the space within the kidney occupied by the renal pelvis, calyces, blood vessels, and nerves. The pyramids, columns, and cortex are part of the renal parenchyma.
